title: FIS pricing - No published list price; core banking typically $300K-$1M+/year
clean_text: FIS does not publish official pricing; like other tier-one core banking vendors, contracts are tailored to each client's size, scope, and requirements, combining software licensing, maintenance fees, and transaction-based pricing. Third-party estimates for FIS core banking software typically range from roughly $300,000 to $1 million per year, with large banks paying closer to $1 million annually and smaller firms spending a few hundred thousand. Broader FIS software engagements are estimated to average around $1 million annually, with the maximum reported reaching approximately $5.5 million for larger, more complex deployments.
